# JoinOrder Q8c — Canonical JoinOrder 8c

> [JoinOrder](../../join-order.md) benchmark · [all JoinOrder queries](index.md)

Canonical JoinOrder SQL query 8c; generated DataFrame translation

## Representative SQL

Rendered in the benchmark's native SQL with default parameters (no dialect translation available).

```sql
SELECT MIN(a1.name) AS writer_pseudo_name,
       MIN(t.title) AS movie_title
FROM aka_name AS a1,
     cast_info AS ci,
     company_name AS cn,
     movie_companies AS mc,
     name AS n1,
     role_type AS rt,
     title AS t
WHERE cn.country_code ='[us]'
  AND rt.role ='writer'
  AND a1.person_id = n1.id
  AND n1.id = ci.person_id
  AND ci.movie_id = t.id
  AND t.id = mc.movie_id
  AND mc.company_id = cn.id
  AND ci.role_id = rt.id
  AND a1.person_id = ci.person_id
  AND ci.movie_id = mc.movie_id;
```
